q1_issues.issue: (Member strasbourg city) types a proper noun from world knowledge — no kind word for Strasbourg appears in the text.
(Member france country) is the same unstated typing for the second place name.
(Member sk_producers_1 leading) predicates a descriptive modifier of the group symbol rather than distributing it over the members, the reading the plural rules explicitly warn against.

q2_gaps: a predicative partitive "X is one of the Ns" — the partitive section quantifies a subset that then carries the predicate, and has no shape for a copular clause whose whole content is the subject's membership in the definite set
notes: PartOf for "one of the ..." is a reasonable fallback (linking a named member to a group) given the gap above, and the participial "based in" routed to the stative LocatedIn rather than a reduced-relative event is defensible since the rule names "is located in / is situated in". The still-make relative clause correctly keeps the group event plus the per-member distribution rule at 1.0/0.9, and "a handful" is stored as a CardinalityPhrase with no invented number.
